name: Disk map
description: What is taking up the room: a ring of folders you can walk into, mark, and have the application clear away.
author: xcommander

views.title: Disk map
views.description: A ring of what is taking up the room.

settings.label: Rings
settings.note: How deep the chart goes. A panel is narrow, so it always draws one ring fewer than this.

settings.label: Wedges per ring
settings.note: Everything past this is gathered into one wedge, so a folder of ten thousand files still draws.

settings.label: Measure again after
settings.note: Minutes. A folder that has been measured is remembered and drawn at once; past this it is walked again on opening. Rescan always reads it afresh.

settings.label: Count hidden files
settings.note: They take up room whether or not they are shown in the panel.

settings.label: Walk the other panel along
settings.note: Opening a folder in the chart also sends the panel beside it there.

settings.label: Read local folders directly
settings.note: Faster on a big local disk. Turn it off to walk everything through the application instead, which is the only way anything but the local disk is ever read.
